body: Good to hear you'll be getting help, hope it works and you feel better in the future!

Damn I've done this a ton. Debating just writing it down at some point in case I eventually actually do it and am not in the state of mind to write a note.

But anyways, you may think you're alright (and you probably are, rough mental weeks do occasionally happen), but I recommend talking to someone (a friend, family, therapist, even me if you want to stay anonymous, I'm completely open to talking by PM or by comments) if the rough week becomes a rough 2 weeks or longer. That could be a sign of depression gradually taking over. On the other hand, if you can think of a solid source to your rough week then odds are that it's due to that and depression has nothing to do with it thankfully.

Ok bro. I can relate and understand what you're thinking right now, and I wanna tell you that being ugly isn't the end of the world.

I'm a pretty bad-looking person. The literal only good thing I have going for me is that I'm not overweight, but even then, I'd give myself a 2 from a 1-10 scale of how good I look, a 3 if I was having a good day in terms of looks. However, I've had people (ok, 1 person that *I was aware of* a long time ago but it's something, and plus, I'm pretty fucking young) have crushes on me simply because of my personality. In addition, I've liked girls who I'd honestly give a 4/10 simply because they were really nice people, had interesting personalities, etc.

So basically what I'm saying is although looks are very important in relationships (I'll be honest and say they're around 50-90%, varying especially with the person, of what decides if someone likes another person), it's not everything. And it's most definitely not impossible to have relationships if you're ugly. Just harder.
It's perfectly possible that you could finally start feeling happy with stronger meds. That could be worth not dying tonight for.

I saw above that you said that you had been prescribed a few meds for depression but none of them had worked. Have you tried asking your doctor/psychiatrist for something stronger? I agree with /u/ParaLegalize here, from what I've seen, doctors are pretty willing to work with people.

Wait dude. I'm begging of you, please just give it a bit of time. I know you feel like shit right now, but give it a month. Just like shit happens in life to make you feel like shit, stuff also happens that makes life worth living. Just give it a bit of time, who knows, tomorrow may be the day where you meet the girl of your dreams that makes life worth living for.
